identity.title: Pokémon Ranger: The Road to a "Capture" Master

leadText:
(Japanese: ポケモンレンジャー“キャプチャ”マスターへの道 Pokémon Ranger: The Road to a "Capture" Master) is one of the adaptations of the Pokémon Ranger series games. It appeared in two CoroCoro Comic Special issues: April and June 2008. It was created by 吉野恵美子 Emiko Yoshino.

 
 

 
 

zh:宝可梦巡护员 “捕猎”大师之道
